LanguageData.VoidAwake_Ghost.label: ghost
LanguageData.VoidAwake_Ghost.description: A skeletal ghost bound by the void. It feels no pain.
LanguageData.VoidAwake_Mortal.label: mortal
LanguageData.VoidAwake_Mortal.description: A curse that sharpens the dead each time they fall. At first it does nothing, but every death makes them faster and more lethal — and more fragile. The third death awakens it.

LanguageData.VoidAwake_Mortal.stages.1.label: first death
LanguageData.VoidAwake_Mortal.stages.2.label: second death
LanguageData.VoidAwake_Mortal.stages.3.label: awakened
